notes.title: SKIBIDI BACKROOMS v1.0 - 8 players in the lobby!
notes.content:
[h2]HELLO EVERYONE![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/c58d5d585a9c4d344c144387a1096dc792f04425.gif[/img]

[h2]We are pleased to announce that we are leaving early access. We settled on version 0.6 and completed all the main tasks for developing the game.
But this does not mean that we will stop developing and releasing updates![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704197/bb8159e0ab098a158c5e88ed0635f78f80cba3c2.png[/img]

[h2]It all depends on you, write reviews, put tags so that as many people as possible can see our game!
The larger the community and feedback, the more actively we will work on the next updates.[/h2]

store.steampowered.com/app/2515210/

[h3]RELEASE v1.0[/h3]

[list]
[*] 8 players in the lobby!
[*] All character models have been completely redesigned.
[*] The sound has been improved - it should now be more spacious.
[*] Fix voice chat.
[*] Improved translation into all languages.
[/list]
